postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n lines.
Each line in the output contains exactly two integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(abs(int(coord)) <= 10**9 for coord in line.split()) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each coordinate in the output is within the range of -10^9 to 10^9.

postconditions.expression: len(set(tuple(line.split()) for line in output)) == n
postconditions.description: All knights are in different cells.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for line1 in output for line2 in output if abs(int(line1.split()[0]) - int(line2.split()[0])) <= 1 and abs(int(line1.split()[1]) - int(line2.split()[1])) <= 1) == 0

invariants.description: The knights are placed according to the rules of the task.
